verdict.rationale: Pulumi automations are code-first programs, and Pulumi maintains its own GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps integrations, so versioning is supported (pulumi-gh-1, pulumi-docs-12). Review is covered by `pulumi preview`, which shows changes without applying them, and by policy violations posted in pull request comments and checks (pulumi-docs-8, pulumi-docs-40). Rollback is not documented anywhere in the pack; the only nearby evidence is that the Cloud REST API tracks state history (pulumi-docs-50). Missing for 10: a documented rollback or revert-to-prior-state capability, explicit docs on stack update history and versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the version/review/rollback workflow.
